body.purpose: Running copy, lh 1.7-1.8, 62-68ch measure in guides.

motion.name: transition
motion.purpose: Single global easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one CTA style: black fill, lime hover flip, loading-aware.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c6ff00; color: #000; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Category Pill
components.description: Multi-select category chip; active state fills Street Lime.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 2px solid #f5f5f5; background: #fff; color: #000; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #c6ff00; background: #fdfbf7; } .ds-pill-active { background: #c6ff00; border-color: #c6ff00; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Form Card
components.description: The shared white form surface used by every form page.
components.css: .ds-form-card { background: #fff; padding: 3rem; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); max-width: 600px; } .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #000; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border: 2px solid #f5f5f5; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; background: #fff; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c6ff00; }

components.name: Page Hero
components.description: The shared subpage header: centered Hanson title, Barlow tagline and subtitle.
components.html:
London Retail Partners

Sell on STREET. Reach London customers.

Let us bring shoppers to you and increase your exposure.
components.css: .ds-page-hero { text-align: center; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-page-title { font-family: 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; color: #000; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-page-tagline { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #666; margin: 0.5rem auto 1.25rem; max-width: 720px; } .ds-page-subtitle { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #666; }

components.name: Route Waypoint
components.description: Signature wayfinding motif: black signage tile with lime numeral on a route spine.
components.html:
1. Newburgh Street

    Mark Powell AT No. 2

  2. Foubert's Place

    adidas Originals AT No. 8
components.css: .ds-route { list-style: none; counter-reset: leg; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 3rem; position: relative; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-route::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.85rem; top: 0.9rem; bottom: 1.4rem; width: 2px; background: #f5f5f5; } .ds-route-leg { counter-increment: leg; position: relative; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; } .ds-route-leg::before { content: counter(leg); position: absolute; left: -3rem; top: -0.1rem; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #000; color: #c6ff00; font-family: 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-route-street { font-family: 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #000; margin: 0 0 1rem; } .ds-route-stop { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #000; margin: 0; } .ds-route-at { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #666; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed cream bar with blur, Hanson logo, Barlow links, black CTA.
components.html: STREETFeaturesFAQJoin the Waitlist
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1.25rem 2rem; background: rgba(253,251,247,0.98); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #000; } .ds-nav-links { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2.5rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: #000; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #666; } .ds-nav-cta { background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: The site borrows its grammar from street furniture and wayfinding: black signage tiles with lime numerals, route spines that walk you shop by shop, breadcrumbs, and one loud lime accent that works like a painted kerb line. Everything sits on a warm cream ground with white surfaces floating gently above it — bold but friendly, chunky display type softened by rounded corners and pill shapes. Density is generous and editorial; the system is deliberately small: one display face, one body face, one accent, three shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, white cards, black ink, lime signal
Hanson display type used sparingly and always in charge
Wayfinding motifs: numbered black waypoint tiles, route spines, breadcrumbs
Soft ambient shadows; no borders doing depth work

rules.name: The Kerb Line Rule
rules.body: Lime is a signal, not a surface. It appears on interaction, on waypoints, and on small brand marks — never as large fills behind text blocks and never as text on cream/white.

rules.name: The One Shout Rule
rules.body: Hanson appears only where it leads: page titles, section headings, the logo, waypoint numerals, pull-quote marks. Never for paragraphs, labels, or buttons.

rules.name: The No Outline Rule
rules.body: Cards never take borders. If a surface needs separation from white, it gets a sand tint or a shadow step, not a stroke.

dos: Do start every subpage with the shared page-hero block and let --page-top handle nav clearance — never hardcode top padding on a page shell.
Do put lime on black (or black on lime) exclusively; check any new text/background pair against 4.5:1.
Do use Slate (--gray-dark) for all secondary text on light grounds; --gray is decorative only.
Do give every form submit a disabled/loading state and an inline .form-error — no alert().
donts: Don't create a new hero, title, or form-card style per page; extend the shared classes in globals.css.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, or bordered cards — all previously shipped and deliberately removed.
Don't set Hanson below ~1.4rem or use it for running text.
Don't publish delivery-time claims in any copy surface (CAP Code 3.7 — the slogan is 'Delivered', no minute numbers).
